Nina (partnerships): Atlas just flagged a customs discrepancy on PO AT-920. possible 48h hold. anyone free to triage?
Omar (logistics): 48h will hit two Dedicated installs. which depots?
Nina (partnerships): UK-LON and DE-FRA are affected. Claire, your customers?
Claire (sales): One is LaunchCo (can't move). Other is SoftServe (can flex). Need buffer plan.
Vik (vendor-Atlas): Sorry team 0 we have a mismatched tariff line on the BOL. Reissuing corrected docs now. ETA 45m.
Omar (logistics): Options: 1) conditional marketplace hold for a parity rack (no charge unless used) 2) priority canary from Atlas if they can split shipment 3) request expedited correction with customs (may be 24-48h).
ops-bot: Marketplace availability: MKP-UK-01 (1 rack), MKP-DE-02 (1 rack). Conditional hold token: HOLD-AT920.
Nina (partnerships): Vik, can Atlas split a 1-rack canary and guarantee firmware batch?
Vik (vendor-Atlas): Yes 5 we'll push serials + fw tags and a canary container C-AT-77 for original ETA.
Omar (logistics): I'll provisionally reserve MKP holds and prep trucking for a canary. Claire, i'll coordinate customer msg: "temporary parity rack available to avoid launch impact."
Claire (sales): will craft comms. thanks.
Nina (partnerships): action items: Atlas upload corrected BOL + CSV (Vik), Omar reserve marketplace hold & trucking (Omar), Claire send LaunchCo note (Claire). please ack with :thumbsup: when done.
